highlights: Developed a network dataset in ArcGIS Network Analyst to evaluate service-areas related to housing needs.
Compiled and evaluated housing and demographic datasets, supporting city-wide housing needs analysis across 50+ variables and datasets.
Conducted network-based spatial analyses of housing conditions using ArcGIS Pro, informing municipal planning decisions and future development scenarios across all of Eugene.

Performed quality control and spatial verification of historical records using SQL and GIS tools, improving data accuracy and consistency for 200+ records in the City of Eugene’s Cultural Resources database.
Developed a high-resolution 3D model of the historical Coquille River Basin using Blender and GIS-derived inputs, enhancing ecological education and stakeholder communication.
Integrated spatial datasets and automated workflows using ArcGIS Pro, QGIS, and Python, creating a structured and reproducible modeling methodology.
Presented project methodology and visualizations to a professional audience at the American Fisheries Society Oregon Chapter (2023), communicating results to 100+ attendees.
